reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread in #north-team to confirm I've noted that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November.

I couldn't save it to gbrain. It refused the request because this bot's token isn't linked to any member, so I couldn't read or write anything there. For now, her message and my reply in the thread are the only record. I also checked the shared files and there's no Brackenwater account folder I can see.

If you want the brain to work for the shared bot, someone on the brain host needs to link the token to the members it acts for. The error message suggests `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --may-act-for <members>`, or `--member <MEMBER>` to link it to one person. That's an admin decision, so I haven't run it.
